The phrase “targets above” is visible, but the target genes are outside the crop and therefore cannot be identified.

The exact identity of the “treatment group” associated with higher MMP12 and IL-6 expression is not restated in the same sentence, although αCD163/LNP-FAPCAR is the immediately preceding treatment context.
No visible evidence concerning gene editing, insertion, deletion, or phagocytosis is present.
